Design.title: AFF design system
Design.intro: African excellence meets Scandinavian innovation. Calm, confident and warm: clear surfaces, strong typography and earth colours used with restraint.

colour.scalesIntro: Raw values. Used only in the token file; components use the semantic colours below.
colour.semanticIntro: Every pair is checked against WCAG 2.1 AA, in light and dark themes.

typography.intro: Fraunces for headings, Inter for everything else. Both include æ, ø and å.
typography.sample: Blåbærsyltetøy, jollof og ærlig mat på Tøyen
typography.alphabet: Aa Bb Cc Dd Ee Ff Gg Hh Ii Jj Kk Ll Mm Nn Oo Pp Qq Rr Ss Tt Uu Vv Ww Xx Yy Zz Ææ Øø Åå 0123456789

spacing.intro: 4 px grid. Generous space is part of the look.

shadow.intro: Warm, soft shadows. Cards use sm; menus and dialogs use lg.

motion.intro: Short, calm transitions. Turned off when the user asks for reduced motion.

motif.intro: One geometric motif: a thin band of stepped diamonds. Used sparingly – in the footer, at the top of the storefront and as the mark beside the logo. Never as a background pattern.

shells.portal: Portal for vendors, sponsors and admins
shells.menuItemDesc: Smoked tomato, pepper and grilled chicken.

photography.intro: Images show real people, real food and real atmosphere.
doItems: Natural light, ideally evening sun and warm tones.
Real vendors at their own stalls, at work.
Food up close: texture, steam, hands serving.
Calm backgrounds and space around the subject.
dontItems: Clichés such as safari imagery and tribal patterns.
Heavy filters, oversaturated colour or flash.
Photos of people without their consent.
